title: BlackRoad Root Domain
description: Canonical record for one of the 20 BlackRoad root domains. Registry/domains.json is the single source of truth; the DOMAINS array in index.html is generated from it via scripts/sync-collections.mjs.

name.description: Canonical lowercase ASCII root hostname, e.g. blackroad.io; no URL, port, wildcard, or trailing dot. Names must be unique and roots must not overlap (enforced across records by the collection validator).

board.description: One-line description of what the domain board covers.

queue.description: Demo seed count, not a receipt-backed metric.

blocked.description: Demo seed count, not a receipt-backed metric.

stageIdx.description: Demo seed stage index, not a receipt-backed metric.

nextRoads.description: Canonical root or subdomain hostnames under exactly one registered root; checked by validate-references.mjs.

products.description: Product names from Registry/products.json; checked by validate-references.mjs.

agents.description: Agent names from Registry/agents.json; checked by validate-references.mjs.
